Lovely restaurant, very kind staff!
Sep 2026 • Couples
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had such a wonderful experience at La Lola Saigon! A special mention to Jane, who was absolutely fantastic. She was courteous, very professional, attentive, and always greeted us with a beautiful smile. Her service really made our visits even more enjoyable.

The food at La Lola Saigon is absolutely beautiful — everything we’ve tried has been delicious and full of flavour. We’ve actually visited at least three times in the past six days while staying in Ho Chi Minh City, which says a lot about how much we love this restaurant!

I would highly recommend La Lola Saigon to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. Great food, fantastic service, and a lovely atmosphere. And if you’re lucky enough to have Jane looking after you, you’re in for a real treat! ❤️

We’ll definitely be back! 🇻🇳🍽️

Beautifully Crafted, Rich Flavors
Jul 2026 • Solo
I got the Foie Gras Toast. The foie gras itself was silky, smooth, and melted beautifully. While the caramelized onions and red wine reduction were flavorful, I felt they became the dominant ones on the plate. I would have preferred a composition that highlighted foie gras' rich, buttery, and livery character. I also ordered the Iberico Presa Steak. The pork wasn’t very juicy and tender, but it felt rich because of the fat. The crust was a bit uneven and lacked some smokiness. I love the berry and mustard emulsion, but the pork jus was a bit salty. The addition of fennel was a great idea, and the mashed potato was smooth and creamy. Lastly, I got the La Lola's Kiss. I like the contrasting flavor of sweet and sour in this dessert, but sourness clearly dominated here. The sorbet was smooth and fruity, and I also appreciate the textural details of the jelly and cucumber.

“Julio’s Touch of Magic”
Nov 2025 • Friends
I had such a great time at Chef Julio’s Mediterranean restobar. The place has this vibrant yet relaxed vibe that instantly puts you in a good mood. The highlight of my night was definitely the foie gras—perfectly seared, rich, and lifted with those Mediterranean touches Chef Julio is known for. Watching him prepare the paella live was a real treat—aromas filling the room and the final dish bursting with flavor. The mezze was spot-on, the seafood was fresh and delicious, and every plate looked as good as it tasted. The staff were warm, easygoing, and made the whole experience feel special without trying too hard. Honestly, a memorable meal—I’m already thinking about my next visit!
